description: This file implements HMAC hash functions used in TLS, including functions for MD5 and SHA, as part of the TLS Crypto Provider Object. It contains definitions for functions like TlsCpoHmac, TlsCpoHmac_MD5, and TlsCpoHmac_SHA, which perform hashing operations using an internal cryptographic provider object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsCpoHmac(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG mac_algorithm,void * i_secret,ULONG i_secret_size,void * i_data,ULONG i_data_size,void * o_hash,PULONG o_hash_size)
methods.description: Selects the appropriate hashing function based on the specified algorithm (MD5 or SHA) and performs HMAC using the internal methods of the TLS Crypto Provider Object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsCpoHmac_MD5(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,void * i_secret,ULONG i_secret_size,void * i_data,ULONG i_data_size,void * o_hash,PULONG o_hash_size)
methods.description: Performs HMAC-MD5 on the input data using the specified secret, utilizing internal cryptographic functions and copying the result to the output buffer.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsCpoHmac_SHA(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,void * i_secret,ULONG i_secret_size,void * i_data,ULONG i_data_size,void * o_hash,PULONG o_hash_size)
methods.description: Performs HMAC-SHA1 on the input data using the specified secret, utilizing internal cryptographic functions and copying the result to the output buffer.
